messages:
maya: Quick thread 1 Boardwalk asked for a 4-week POC for a product KB assistant. Must support ~64k ingestion (or equivalent retrieval), tool-calls to their FAQ DB (read/write), and embeddings + reranker. They9re asking for hosted vs dedicated vs private cost/ops. Pilot needs to run in 4 weeks. Thoughts?
samir: Are their acceptance criteria formalized? We need concrete pass/fail metrics before planning. Also who9s the security contact for the questionnaire?
ev an: For 64k we have two choices: native long-context model or chunk+retrieve. Practical POC path = chunking -> embeddings -> reranker -> 13B/34B generator with tool-calls. Pros: cheaper and faster to stand up. Con: retrieval latency. We should include a small long-context experiment for comparison.
jordan: High level on pricing: hosted = fastest setup, pay-as-you-go; dedicated = commit/discount, lower unit cost; private = biggest setup overhead. I can sketch three cost buckets once scope (qps, retention) is locked.
tess-legal: I'll take the security questionnaire. Ask them to send form to laura@boardwalk-sec. They9ll want SOC2 docs, KMS integration approach, data residency (EU) and log retention policy.
kai-infra: For tool-calls we recommend a signing proxy + short-lived creds. We can provide a sample connector and a Dockerized example for the POC. Private on-prem GPUs add ~3-4w procurement. VPC-hosted private ~2w if they can give AWS access.
maya: Customer provided preliminary acceptance criteria: top-1 retrieval precision >= 78% on their 500-sample set, reranker nDCG@3 >= 0.72, end-to-end p95 latency < 800ms for interactive flows, tool-call roundtrip < 1.2s. They9ll upload eval set + sample docs by EOD.
ev an: Proposed POC plan (high-level):
- Week 0 (kickoff): confirm eval set, infra access, security intake
- Week 1: baseline embeddings + 13B generator, measure top-1
- Week 2: add 1B reranker fine-tune on their pairs, measure nDCG@3
- Week 3: long-context trial (32k model) on hardest 50 queries, measure latency/cost
- Week 4: run acceptance evals, handoff + recommendations
Include token-level cost estimates per experiment.
samir: Nice. Jordan — please prepare two pricing scenarios for the customer call: hosted burstable with expected month cost, and dedicated 3-month commit with per-token breakouts. Call out any one-time integration or infra setup fees.
jordan: Will prepare slides. Also will include delta if they choose private (VPC or on-prem).
tess-legal: I9ve pinged laura@boardwalk-sec for questionnaire. I9ll attach SOC2 summary and KMS notes; ask if they need any DPA language or specific retention controls.
kai-infra: We9ll submit a connector repo in the POC branch. It will expose two endpoints: /sign and /proxy -> supports read/write and short-lived tokens. I9ll add a README and example curl.
deploy-bot: demo infra job 1298 started (env: poc-boardwalk). Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/1298
maya: Action items: (1) jordan: pricing options + per-experiment cost, (2) evan: detailed experiment plan + scripts to run, (3) tess: start security intake, (4) kai: connector example + deploy steps. Follow-up sync Thursday 11am PT.
samir: If private becomes a blocker, default to hosted for the demo and iterate. Also add regression tests for hallucination on the eval set.
maya: Thanks team 1 I9ll share drive link and calendar invite once jordan and evan have drafts.
